about: The owner asks why the How it works `.index.md` files were not made next to README and vision. They existed only in the mirror folder `vision/tree/...`; now every file that exists as a draft (README, vision, the agent, the skills, and the `.claude/`, `agents/`, `skills/` folders) keeps its index file next to it.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
